scope: eight zero field bits crash the client; the field loop has no clean terminator

experiment.layout: count1 body + 8 zero field bits at bit1329 + actor/sub4/glass/EOF

reasoning: 0x671700 reads at least two bits per field (a flag, and a second flag), so 8 zero bits cover at most four fields
the field loop in 0x471D80 is gated only by the stream error flag, not by a field count
so the loop keeps consuming whatever follows (the actor block), runs off the buffer and sets the error flag
with count=1 the body therefore cannot both provide fields and keep the tail blocks intact unless the loop terminates by reaching length exactly - and even then the error flag is what ends it

pivot.caveat: this is a diagnostic, not the final protocol solution
